en_title: George Lucas Says His Changes to The Original Star Wars Trilogy Were Justified as Movies Always Get 'Yanked Out of Your Hands' For Release
cn_title: 卢卡斯解释为何反复修改《星球大战》原三部曲
subtitle: 电影还没拍完，就得上映
opus_summary: 乔治·卢卡斯为多次修改《星球大战》原三部曲辩护，称电影往往尚未完成就得赶上上映期限，之后的修改是为了完成作品。他承认不少人对此不满。未经后续修改的1977年原版电影将于2027年2月重映。

paragraphs.en: Star Wars creator George Lucas has defended his frequent tweaks to the series' original movies, while acknowledging that "a lot of people got upset" about the changes.
paragraphs.cn: 《星球大战》创作者乔治·卢卡斯为自己多次修改系列早期电影辩护，同时承认这些改动让「很多人感到不满」。

paragraphs.en: Lucas' numerous updates to the classic Star Wars trilogy have become a legendary source of debate for fans, with each of Lucas' many, many subsequent alterations sparking discussion on whether they were advisable or necessary.
paragraphs.cn: 卢卡斯对《星球大战》经典三部曲的多次修改，早已成为粉丝争论不休的话题。他此后一次又一次动手改片，每次都引发讨论：这些改动是否妥当，又是否必要？

paragraphs.en: The trilogy's 1997 Special Edition release, which made major alterations and added an array of new CGI effects, was mostly well-received (with one notable exception we'll get to below). But Lucas has continued to tinker with the movies in the years since. Further changes were made to the movies for their DVD release in 2004, and again for their Blu-ray launch in 2011. More minor adjustments were even made for their Disney+ launch in 2019, over 40 years on from their original debut.
paragraphs.cn: 1997年推出的三部曲特别版改动颇大，还加入了大量新的CGI特效，总体上获得了不错的反响（不过有一个值得注意的例外，下文会谈到）。此后，卢卡斯仍不断修改这些电影：2004年推出DVD版时改过一次，2011年推出蓝光版时又改了一次。到了2019年，距离影片最初上映已过去40多年，它们登陆Disney+时甚至还有一些小幅调整。

paragraphs.en: Some of these changes are unlikely to register to casual viewers, such as Obi-Wan Kenobi's shout to scare off the Tusken Raiders on Tatooine (which was changed for the 2004 DVD release, and then again for the 2011 Blu-ray). Others are more technical in nature, fixing color mistakes or improving the appearance of matte backgrounds.
paragraphs.cn: 有些改动，普通观众可能根本注意不到。比如欧比旺·肯诺比在塔图因星吓退塔斯肯袭击者时的喊声，2004年DVD版改过，2011年蓝光版又改了一次。另一些则偏向技术层面，比如修正色彩错误，或改善绘景背景的效果。

paragraphs.en: But other edits have sparked significant criticism, such as the changes made to link the original movies with Lucas' prequel trilogy (such as the digital removal of Anakin Skywalker's eyebrows for Return of the Jedi's launch on DVD, or the addition of Hayden Christensen as Anakin's Force ghost).
paragraphs.cn: 但也有一些修改招致了大量批评，比如为了让早期电影与卢卡斯的前传三部曲衔接而做的改动。《星球大战：绝地归来》推出DVD版时，阿纳金·天行者的眉毛被数码技术抹去；影片中阿纳金的原力幽灵也换成了海登·克里斯滕森的形象。

paragraphs.en: And then there's the infamous 'who shot first?' debate in A New Hope's scene with Han Solo and the bounty hunter Greedo. The identity of who shot first (and the resulting implications this had for Han's personality) was reversed in the 1997 Special Edition, shortened for the 2004 DVD, shortened further for the 2011 Blu-ray, and even tweaked with new visual effects in a 2019.
paragraphs.cn: 还有《星球大战：新希望》中汉·索罗与赏金猎人格里多那场戏引发的著名争论：「谁先开的枪？」1997年的特别版颠倒了双方开枪的先后顺序，也因此影响了观众对汉性格的理解。2004年DVD版缩短了两次开枪之间的间隔，2011年蓝光版又进一步缩短；到了2019年，这段戏甚至还加入了新视觉效果，再次作出调整。

paragraphs.en: Reflecting on the changes now in an interview with CBS , Lucas characterized his edits as him finally getting a chance to complete his stories, after initially having to meet production deadlines.
paragraphs.cn: 近日接受CBS采访、回顾这些改动时，卢卡斯表示，当初制作电影必须赶上期限，而后来的修改终于让他有机会把故事完成。

paragraphs.en: "Most movies aren't finished, they're simply yanked out of your hands and put in the theaters," Lucas said. "So you're always saying 'oh, I wish I could have just finished that one piece of thing.' But it's not that way. You have a deadline, you've got to make the deadline.
paragraphs.cn: 卢卡斯说：「大多数电影都还没完成，就被人从你手里拿走，送进了影院。所以你总会想，‘唉，要是能把那一小部分做完就好了。’可现实不是这样。你有截止日期，就必须赶上。」

paragraphs.en: "But then I went back, after Star Wars, and redid all the movies, in terms of finishing them. So that they're actually finished. And of course, a lot of people got upset about that, because they said 'you're not allowed to do that.' I said 'fans are doing that. They're making alternate versions and all kinds of stuff.'"
paragraphs.cn: 「但后来，在《星球大战》之后，我回头把所有电影都重新处理了一遍，算是把它们做完了。这样它们才真正完成。当然，很多人对此感到不满，因为他们说‘你不能这么做’。我说，‘粉丝也在这么做。他们制作各种不同版本，还有其他各式各样的东西。’」

paragraphs.en: Of course, it is Lucas' right to revisit his work however he pleases — and it is also the right of Star Wars fans to have their say in response. But Lucas concluded by mentioning how vociferous the debate around Star Wars has now become. The creator has previously suggested that the negative fan reaction to his changes (and his prequel movies) was a factor in his ultimate decision to sell the franchise to Disney.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，卢卡斯有权按自己的意愿重新修改作品，《星球大战》粉丝也有权对此发表看法。不过，卢卡斯最后谈到了如今围绕《星球大战》的争论有多激烈。他此前曾表示，粉丝对这些改动以及前传电影的负面反应，是他最终决定将这个系列卖给迪士尼的原因之一。

paragraphs.en: "It's hard to explain to the studios that if you listen to the people who are unhappy, it's not going to turn out well," Lucas noted. "It's going to be sad. Because they're not people who know how to make movies."
paragraphs.cn: 卢卡斯说：「很难向制片厂解释，如果听那些不满的人的话，结果不会好。这会很可悲，因为他们并不懂怎么拍电影。」

paragraphs.en: For those keen to see Star Wars in all its 1977 glory, the original movie will return to theaters (without all of Lucas' subsequent changes) for a limited release in February 2027 , in honor of the film's 50th anniversary.
paragraphs.cn: 想在影院看到1977年原貌的《星球大战》的观众，将有机会如愿：为纪念影片上映50周年，未经卢卡斯后续修改的原版电影将于2027年2月限时重映。
